status: PROVISIONAL — priors derived from published effect sizes. NOT fitted to the GutEquity cohort. Replace at milestone M2.

provenance.dsi_weights: Siegel CA et al. Gut 2018;67:244-254, as tabulated in Swaminathan A et al. Inflamm Bowel Dis 2024;30:2064-2075 Fig 1.
provenance.beta_severity: Swaminathan 2024: baseline DSI aOR 1.05 per point (95% CI 1.02-1.09) for complicated course at 24 months. ln(1.05)*10 = 0.4879 per 10 points.
provenance.baseline_risk: Swaminathan 2022 APT: 49/172 = 28.5% complicated course at 12 months. Swaminathan 2024: 71/171 = 41.5% at 24 months.
provenance.serology: Bertha M et al. Inflamm Bowel Dis 2018;24:209-216 (n=358 African American CD). Complicated disease: IgG ASCA OR 2.67 (1.67-4.28), anti-OmpC OR 2.23 (1.41-3.53). Surgery: 2.51 (1.49-4.22), 3.57 (2.12-6.00). No interaction with European admixture was observed, so serology enters UNCONDITIONED on ancestry.
provenance.prs: Somineni HK et al. Am J Hum Genet 2021;108:431-445 — ancestry-appropriate weights improve prediction in the highest risk percentiles. Deliberately conservative per-SD prior; the evidence supports top-percentile enrichment, not a large per-SD effect.

crp.comment: Smooth logistic replacement for the 3/5 mg/L steps. Re-estimate stratum-specific cut-points at M2.

anaemia.comment: WHO thresholds. Haemoglobinopathy status to be entered as a covariate at M2 (ibd.docx section 7).

care_propensity.comment: P(a patient with this biology is on advanced therapy). gamma_severity applies to GERI-B/100. Provisional; fit to the cohort at M2 as a logistic model of ever-advanced-therapy on GERI-B and the phenotype alert.

risk.shrinkage_rationale: Both terms are SHRUNK from their published effect sizes because the published estimates are largely unadjusted for concurrent severity, and GERI-B already carries that severity. Bertha's serology odds ratios (2.67 and 2.23) contrast complicated with uncomplicated disease; a patient scoring 65 on GERI-B is already most of the way to 'complicated', so adding the full log-odds counts the same signal twice. The phenotype alert double-counts more directly still: a fistula contributes 11 points to GERI-B and also fires the alert. A shrinkage of 0.5 and 0.3 is a placeholder, not an estimate. The correct values come from milestone M2's incremental-value test — fitting the composite with and without the constitutional layer is the same comparison that decides the M2 go/no-go, so this coefficient and that milestone are answered by one analysis.
risk.band_rationale: The BAND is the deliverable; the point estimate is provisional and is not calibrated in the tails. Displaying 97.7% asserts a precision these coefficients cannot support. Report the band, show the point estimate beside it, and say which it is. Revisit once M2 supplies a calibration slope.
risk.derivation: beta_severity_per10 = ln(1.05)*10 = 0.4879, from Swaminathan 2024's baseline DSI aOR of 1.05 per point (95% CI 1.02-1.09) for a complicated course. beta0_12mo places the cohort median DSI of 23 (IQR 12-39, Swaminathan 2024 Table 1) at the observed 12-month event rate of 28.5% (Swaminathan 2022): logit(0.285) - 0.4879*2.3 = -2.0425. The 24-month intercept is shifted by ln of the marginal odds ratio between the 41.5% and 28.5% event rates, ln(1.780) = 0.5766.
risk.known_deficiency: This prior is deliberately conservative and UNDER-SEPARATES the tails. It puts a DSI of 12 at 18.9% risk where the reported sensitivity of 84% and specificity of 72% at threshold 23 imply about 8.1% below threshold and 54.5% above. A steeper slope fitted to those two group means (0.11853 per point) was tested and rejected: it drives a DSI of 65 to a 12-month risk above 99%, which no reported group approaches. The published aOR is an ADJUSTED residual per-point effect and so understates the marginal association, but it is the only per-point estimate that exists, and over-fitting a slope to two interpolated group means is the worse error. Refit on the cohort at M2 and report the calibration slope; correcting this under-separation is a named M2 deliverable, not an accepted property.
risk.comment: beta_constitutional multiplies the summed log-odds from PRS and serology. access_offset_reference is the counterfactual guideline-concordant-access level substituted at deployment for the patient's observed access covariates.

benchmarks.comment: The bar GERI must clear. All verified against the source PDFs, not against secondary transcription.

median_dsi_by_endoscopic_activity.note: Swaminathan 2022 — endoscopic activity, NOT complicated course. Do not relabel.
